title: campanula glomerata f. polessica
intro: Campanula glomerata f. polessica, commonly known as Polessk bellflower, is a plant species in the bellflower family. It is native to the Polesie region in Eastern Europe, known for its clusters of blue-purple flowers. The health benefits of Campanula glomerata f. polessica include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help reduce stress and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-anxiety and antimicrobial effects.
